key_design_decisions: config layout {frozen, engine}: 'frozen' is derived at validate time from the manifest's verbatim score-affecting parameters and must equal a fresh derivation (any tampering of either side raises IdentityConfigError); 'engine' carries the numeric run parameters the manifest does not pin (illiq listing-age/DV thresholds, beta tolerance, hard gross/net caps) and fails closed when keys are missing
price-only mechanism clause is test-enforced: feeding two different funding sets to illiq/premfade produces dataclass-identical proposals (funding is booked by the engine, never a signal)
previous_weights is a verbatim passthrough into DecisionProposal; the smoke executor feeds sleeve exposure weights back in each decision

smoke execution harness (not identity): targets sized on fresh equity times a 0.5% cost buffer; 4-phase rebalance order (trim longs, cover shorts, open longs, open shorts); sells sliced within equity-minus-gross headroom because the frozen A2 sell guard conservatively computes gross_before + fill_notional even for reducing sells

known_limitations: The smoke cost regime (fee 4/5 bps, 1-tick slippage, funding convention) is a representative synthetic rehearsal set, NOT the plan section 6 frozen measured schedules; the cost freeze belongs to the data/cost lane and cost_regime_digest here pins only the smoke's own values
observed_at_utc equals the scheduled decision stamp in the rehearsal for byte-determinism; the production engine stamps observed_at at actual run time
ILLIQ numeric eligibility thresholds are engine config by necessity (the manifest pins the listing+DV rule as prose); a future manifest revision that pins numbers must move them into frozen config

The premfade trailing-2688-completed-buckets reading of the formation window is documented in code; if the Q lane's historical replay requires a different bucket alignment, that replay - not the adapter identity - must disclose the difference
Counterfactual diagnostic arms (56d neighbours, inverted books, reverse funding control) are name-reserved only, per plan section 3
